title: outputs/findings.json
description: Single source of truth for every quantitative number in the memo, deck, dashboard and video. Aggregates only. Deterministic: no timestamps; provenance is the input file hash. v0 by narrative; data agent owns from v1.

label.description: Plain-English, as a staff member would read it.

unit.description: pct is on a 0-100 scale (78.5, not 0.785).

n.description: Respondents in the base (valid, non-missing answers) — the denominator count. Always reported.

numerator.description: For pct/count: respondents meeting the condition.

n_missing.description: Respondents in the group excluded for a missing/unknown answer.

denominator.description: Who is in the base, in words: 'students who answered the post item on identifying crises'.

dimension.description: overall | role | county | language | training_month | training_period | ...

level.description: 'all' for overall; 'other_pooled' for pooled small groups.

caveat.description: Required wording for retrospective items, small n, high missingness. '' if none.
